title: CAPITAL CITY BANK GROUP INC 8-K Filing — 2026-04-23
summary: Capital City Bank Group Inc (NASDAQ: CCBG) filed a Form 8-K on April 23, 2026 reporting results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders held April 21, 2026. The filing covers director elections (12 incumbent nominees elected), an advisory vote approving executive compensation, an advisory vote on compensation vote frequency (1 year preferred), and ratification of Forvis Mazars LLP as the company's independent auditor for fiscal year 2026.
key_points: All 12 incumbent director nominees were elected for one-year terms expiring at the 2027 annual meeting.
Shareholders approved executive compensation on an advisory basis with 12,879,981 votes for and 195,515 against.
Shareholders indicated a preference for annual say-on-pay votes (12,051,728 votes) over biennial (186,356) or triennial (851,160) frequencies.
The appointment of Forvis Mazars, LLP as independent auditor for fiscal year 2026 was ratified (14,821,583 votes for).
Total shares voted represented approximately 15.2 million shares with 2.1 million broker non-votes.
